_comment: Branching dialogue. 'choices' branch; 'requires'/'set' read & write story flags; 'give' grants an item. The 'I have!' option only appears after you've entered the cave (sets flag visited_cave).

greet.speaker: Villager
greet.text: Oh! A traveler. Welcome to Greenfields, friend.

ask.speaker: Villager
ask.text: Have you explored the cave to the north yet?

warn.speaker: Villager
warn.text: Careful—slimes lurk in the dark. Here, take this for the road.

impressed.speaker: Villager
impressed.text: Brave one! They say the hollow still hides old treasures.

bye.speaker: Villager
bye.text: Safe travels. Press the menu key any time to rest or save.
